messages:
sasha: Heads up — Market between 4th and 5th is basically a tiny canal. Streetcar hit a wave and sprayed everyone. I now share my office with a very indignant, drenched pigeon. 15m delay into SoMa. Pics if you want (gross). :sob: 
anya: Oh noooo  Which line? N or T? 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Muni N-line: 12 min delay due to water on tracks; reduced speed through Market St. Caltrain: running on time. 
matt: Yup N-line. Walked around and hopped on the 5 bus instead. Took 7 extra mins but stayed dryer. 
jess: Quick poll — who bailed on their usual mode and what did you switch to? React with :bike: bike, :scooter: scooter, :bus: bus, :umbrella: soldiered on. 
aaron: :bike: rode around the mess but shoes are not happy. 
anya: :bus: surrendered the umbrella to the sea. 
sasha: :scooter: reluctantly. RIP sneakers. 
matt: :umbrella: until it turned into a sail. 
jess: LOL. ok that's the commuter mood. Also FYI 2nd St underpass reported flooding — avoid if you can. 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Caltrain: minor delays expected near 4th/King due to rerouted surface traffic. Updates at https://muni.status.example/ (mock link) 
anya: anyone reenacting the soaked-pigeon face? selfie to prove solidarity. :camera_with_flash: 
sasha: uploading pic — warning: soggy bird and muddy shoe close-up. 
aaron: made me snort-laugh at my desk, thanks. :joy: 
jess: If anyone needs fresh socks/liners, I have an extra pair in the office kitchen drawer labeled "commute emergency". First come, first served. 
sasha: you are a hero. :heart: 
matt: Heads up for later commute-ers: bring waterproof bag for laptops, consider delaying if not urgent. Streets look like they're bailing out gutters slowly. 
anya: ETA update — N-line now showing 5 min; probably clearing. 
sasha: thanks! heading into the office cautiously. If pigeon needs adoption I'm taking applications. :bird:
